blocks.tamil_translation: was, (when she set out from Makkah and came to me in Madinah), "My mother has come, she wishes to meet me; may I keep ties of kinship with my mother?" "I asked Rasulullah ﷺ for a religious ruling, and Rasulullah ﷺ replied, "Yes' keep ties of kinship with your mother."

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اَيُّ النَّاسِ اَعْظَمُ حَقًّا عَلَي الْمَرْأَةِ؟ قَالَ: زَوْجُهَا، قُلْتُ: فَاَيُّ النَّاسِ اَعْظَمُ حَقًّا عَلَي الرَّجُلِ؟ قَالَ: اُمُّهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) says: When I asked, "O Rasulullah, to whom is a woman most indebted?" Rasulullah ﷺ replied, "She is most indebted to her husband." When I asked, "To whom is a man most indebted?" the Prophet ﷺ replied, "He is most indebted to his mother."

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ اَنَّ رَجُلاً اَتَي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اِنَّيْ اَصَبْتُ ذَنْبًا عَظِيْمًا فَهَلْ لِيْ تَوْبَةٌ؟ قَالَ: هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ اُمٍّ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ خَالَةٍ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ قَالَ: فَبِرَّهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب في بر الخالة، رقم:١٩٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates: "A man came into the presence of Rasulullah ﷺ and asked, "O Rasulullah, I have committed a grave sin. Will my (tawbah) be accepted?" Rasulullah ﷺ asked, "Is your mother alive?" He said, "No.' "Is your mother's sister
